title: Every football (Soccer ⚽) game has robbed me in the 88th minute. So I'm building one that shows its work.
author: theoldonetwotop11
selftext:
You know the feeling. Your team is better in every way, you're leading, and somehow the game finds a way to take it away. Was it unlucky, or did the game decide? You never find out.

I got tired of not knowing, so I'm building a football game where nothing is hidden. Every pass, tackle and shot is a duel between a skill and its counter-skill, and you can see what tilted it. A better player usually wins, but never always, and you'll always see why.

I'm early in development and I want to know whether I'm the only one who wants this. Vote below, then tell me what makes you angriest in football games.
